name: 48420 · Clio, MI
findings: ZIP 48420 (Clio) has 51 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48420 (Clio) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 48420 (Clio) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 63% of the typical level).

observations.text: 6 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
